rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Dev, Cal, Fay, Ben, Ada, Eli. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 7 and 11 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Dev.say: Proposal: everyone claims only 1 token per round. Total claims then stay within the bank, so all six of us survive every round. Greedy claims just risk proportional cuts that could leave someone short of the 1 they need.

Cal.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token per round. That's all anyone needs to survive, and the bank (13+ tokens this round) covers six 1-token claims in full, so nobody gets cut. Anyone who ends up with spare tokens can give them to players who are short.

Fay.say: Proposal for everyone: claim only what you need to survive this round, which is 1 token. The bank has 6 now plus 7 to 11 arriving, so if all six of us claim 1, everyone is paid in full and nobody is cut. Greedy claims would only shrink the proportional payouts for all of us.

Ben.say: Proposal for everyone: claim only what you need to survive this round (1 token). The bank will hold 13 to 17 after delivery, so if all six of us claim 1, everyone gets a token and nobody is out. Let's keep claims to 1 each and rotate any spare tokens to whoever is short later.

Ada.say: Proposal for everyone: claim just 1 token this round. Six claims of 1 fit easily in the bank, so every player gets exactly what they need to pay their end-of-round token. Greedy claims put people at risk of being out. I'll claim 1.

That is all we need to pay the end-of-round fee, and six claims of 1 fit within the bank's total of at least 13, so everyone gets their full token and nobody is cut back. Taking more than 1 just risks proportional cuts that could leave someone with nothing and out of the game.
